resolution.note: spec/schema v1 for task, record, exposure, contract; krn.json formats; readers exit 78 on unknown major; tasks/ and record literals only in owner; product/workshop rule in boundaries

title: File formats are versioned contracts (S12)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S12 (Sector 4 — Formats and memory (ADR 0017, ADR 0019; item 4)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0017, ADR 0019 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector.
Outcome: `spec/schema/*.v1.json` for task, record, exposure and contract; `krn.json` declares `formats`; readers refuse unknown majors; `tasks/` and record files are reached only through their owner; product/workshop partition in boundaries.ts
Files: see ADR 0017, ADR 0019 Consequences.
Proof: `node --test test/rules/format-contract.test.ts: pass` and `node scripts/boundaries.ts: pass`
Predicted: metric hardcoded-tasks-paths == 0
